notes.title: Kickstarter!
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce that we have launched our Kickstarter campaign for this game! We realized that we need a little bit of help gathering funds for marketing purposes, and we thought that Kickstarter might be a fun way to do that. 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1604197967/mark-after-dark-video-game?ref=nav_search

If you've already checked out this Steam page about our game, then you already have an idea what you're getting into, so let's just get into what the rewards are. ;)

--------------------------------------
Pledge CA$ 1 or more
[h1]I'd Buy That For A Dollar![/h1]

We are so grateful for your pledge, you can have the game for only $1! This is cheaper than the game will cost at the time of release!

Includes:
- Mark After Dark Video Game

--------------------------------------
Pledge CA$ 5 or more
[h1]Take A Picture, It'll Last Longer![/h1]

You get one copy of the game, aaaaand I'll send you a custom image file of YOU interacting with Mark! (I'll need a photo of yo' face though).

lncludes:
- Mark After Dark Video Game
- Personalized Image File

--------------------------------------
Pledge CA$ 10 or more
[h1]Wear You Goin', Baby? (1)[/h1]

You get one copy of the game, and an SVG file with the Hambarfger image or the Bae Dog image to print on whatever your little heart desires! (See Kickstarter page details for sample images.)

lncludes:
- Mark After Dark Video Game
- Either "Hambarfger" or "Bae Dog" File

--------------------------------------
Pledge CA$ 15 or more
[h1]Wear You Goin' Baby? (2)[/h1]

You get one copy of the game, and BOTH of the SVG files with the images you can use to print your own T-shirt, or panties, whatever. Hambarfger and Bae Dog. (See Kickstarter page details for sample images.)

lncludes:
- Mark After Dark Video Game
- "Hambarfger" File
- "Bae Dog" File

--------------------------------------
Pledge CA$ 20 or more
[h1]ALL THE REWARDS! MWHAHA![/h1]

All of the above rewards can be yours for just one easy payment of $19.99! (Just kidding, we Canadians don't use the penny anymore, so we round that up to $20 CAD). 20 bucks (Canadian) will get you one copy of the game, a custom image file of YOU interacting with Mark (please send me a pic of your face or general description of how someone might describe you to the police for this reward), aaaaand you get both SVG image files for personal use (printing, petting, licking, no judge). "Hambarfger" and "Bae Dog". <3

lncludes:
- Mark After Dark Video Game
- Personalized Image File
- "Hambarfger" File
- "Bae Dog" File

--------------------------------------

As always, thank you everyone for all of your love and support. We've had really great feedback so far, and we are more than grateful! <3 x

notes.title: Playtesters Wanted!
notes.content:
We're about two months away from releasing our game on Steam and we are super excited about it!

We just need some more people to volunteer and playtest our game so we can get it really polished. 

The way we've been doing it is:

1.  You email us at: [h1]info@markafterdark.ca[/h1]
2.  We provide you with a Dropbox link with the game file
3.  And a Google Sheets link with our playtest notes template.

So. Got a couple hours to kill?? Please help us! :)

We're looking for:

-  Typos
-  Game-breaking bugs
-  Glitches
-  General feedback on content

As a reward, we will give you a free game code when the game is released on Steam. <3

Thanks in advance!!  xoxo
